scoring: Score each invariant pass or fail from the response. A case passes only if all invariants pass. Use needs_review if the evidence cannot decide. Do not enforce an exact wording, sentence length, or preferred prose/table form. Evaluate ease of comprehension separately; an invariant pass alone is not evidence of better writing.
